messages.content: Help find a housekeeper who provides ironing services.

function.name: get_service_id
function.description: Retrieve the unique identifier for a specific service type, such as cleaning or ironing services. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

service_id.description: The unique identifier of the service. For example, '1' represents cleaning service, and '2' represents ironing service.

unit.description: The unit of measurement for the quantity of service, expressed as the number of service sessions or instances.

message.content:
Here’s a quick play‑book you can follow to locate a reliable housekeeper who offers ironing (or “laundry & pressing”) services: | Step | What to Do | Why It Helps | |------|------------|--------------| | **1️⃣ Define Your Needs** | • How many days per week/month?
• Are there special fabrics/ironing techniques required?
• Need same‑day turnaround? | Gives clarity when asking questions and comparing quotes. | | **2️⃣ Search Online Platforms** | • **TaskRabbit**, **Thumbtuck**, **Handy**, **Bark.com** – filter by “Housekeeping” → “Laundry/Ironing”.
• Local Facebook Groups (“[City] Home Services”, “Neighborhood Help”).
• Nextdoor app – post a request or browse existing listings.
• Google search “iron laundry service near me” + your city name. | These sites aggregate vetted professionals; reviews make comparison easier. | | **3️⃣ Check Professional Directories** | • National Association of Housekeepers (NAH) member directory.
• American Cleaning Institute (ACI).
• State/local home‑services licensing boards. | Membership often means background checks, training, liability coverage. | | **4️⃣ Ask Personal Referrals** | • Friends, family, coworkers, neighbors.
• Real estate agents or property managers may know reputable cleaners. | Word‑of‑mouth referrals usually come from satisfied customers—great trust factor. | | **5️⃣ Verify Credentials** | • Request proof of insurance / bonding.
• Background check results (many agencies offer it).
• References from past clients. | Protects against theft/loss and ensures professionalism. | | **6️⃣ Interview Candidates** | • Discuss experience with delicate items (silk, wool, lace).
• Clarify pricing structure (flat fee vs hourly).
• Confirm availability schedule. | Ensures expectations match reality before hiring. | | **7️⃣ Trial Run** | • Start with a single session or small load.
• Observe quality, timeliness, communication. | Allows you to gauge fit without long‑term commitment. | | **8️⃣ Set Clear Terms** | • Written agreement covering scope, payment terms, cancellation policy.
• Specify what happens if clothes are damaged. | Reduces misunderstandings later. | ### Quick Resource List | Platform | Link | Notes | |----------|------|-------| | TaskRabbit | https://www.taskrabbit.com | Filter by “Cleaning & Laundry”; read ratings. | | Handy | https://www.handy.com | Offers booking through mobile app. | | Thumbtuck | https://thumbtuck.co.uk | UK‑centric; great for local hires. | | Bark | https://bark.com | Get multiple quotes quickly. | | NAH Directory | https://nah.org/members-directory | Find certified members. | | ACI Members | https://cleaninginstitute.org/member-search | U.S. professional association. | | Nextdoor | https://nextdoor.com | Post a request in your neighborhood group. | --- #### Sample Message You Can Send When Reaching Out ``` Hi [Name], I’m looking for a housekeeper who specializes in ironing and general household chores. I’d love to discuss: – Experience with delicate fabrics (silks, wools) – Availability (e.g., twice weekly) – Pricing structure (hourly or flat rate) Could you share your rates, insurance details, and some client references? Thanks, [Your Name] ``` Feel free to tweak the wording based on whether you’re contacting someone directly or posting a job ad. Once you’ve narrowed down candidates, a short trial run will confirm everything works smoothly. Good luck! Let me know if you’d like more detailed instructions on using a particular platform or setting up a contract template.
